hook: Mix paint that behaves like the real thing: red, yellow and blue make every color on the wheel, white makes tints and black makes shades. Then mix to match target colors for stars.
outcome: Mix primary colors into secondary and tertiary colors, build and read the color wheel (warm and cool, complements), and make tints, shades and tones of a color
sources: Paint modeled with Kubelka-Munk mixing of reflectance curves and the CIE 1931 color matching functions (Wyman, Sloan and Shirley fit)
Illustrations generated with Google Gemini, edited for Curio Class
